summary: Admin Invite (email-based) flow — backend (pytest 6/6 PASS) + frontend UI end-to-end verified. Invite via UI emails the invitee, Pending Invites panel lists them, Resend works, manual-password path still creates a normal user (no invite email, not pending).

issues: Pending Invites panel is polluted with 12 stale @example.com invitations left by prior test iterations (write-test-1/2/3, test_ui_*, test_unlock_*, test_lock_*, test_reset_*, test_rolechange_*, test_instructor_a54bf3e1, test_user_5c491fc5, debug-test, test-invite). Cosmetic only — recommend the app add a bulk-delete / auto-expire action, or the team should manually clean via db.users.delete_many({email: /example.com$/, invite_pending: true}).

cases: POST /api/admin/users (no password) → invite:true, invite_email_sent:true, temporary_password:null; db.users has invite_pending=true, invited_by_email set; password_reset_tokens row created
POST /api/auth/reset-password with 7-day invite token → 200, access_token issued, user.role=instructor preserved, invite_pending flips to false, login with new password succeeds
POST /api/admin/users with password → invite:false, temporary_password echoed, invite_pending:false, absent from ?invite_pending=true list

frontend_tests_run.1_invite_via_ui_blank_password: PASS — Filled email delivered@resend.dev + name (leaving password blank) and clicked invite-submit. Success toast observed: 'Invite emailed to delivered@resend.dev — they\'ll set their own password.'
frontend_tests_run.2_pending_invites_panel: PASS — data-testid='pending-invites-panel' visible ('Pending Invites (13)' after add). Entry data-testid='pending-invite-delivered@resend.dev' present with member role badge, invited-date, NO 'email not sent' badge.
frontend_tests_run.3_resend_invite_button: PASS (with caveat) — data-testid='resend-invite-delivered@resend.dev' button visible + clickable; POST /api/admin/users/{id}/resend-invite backend confirmed 200 with success message. UI toast dismissed before capture in the automation harness, but no error was raised and no error toast appeared.
frontend_tests_run.4_manual_password_invite: PASS — qa_manual@resend.dev with typed password produced toast 'User created! Temp password: ManualUIPass123!' and the user does NOT appear in the Pending Invites panel (invite_pending=false).
frontend_tests_run.5_regression_admin_gate: PASS — Valid admin (overflowharvest@gmail.com) reaches /admin/users, no admin-access-denied element. Sidebar Dashboard/File Manager/… all render. (Non-admin gate not re-run — was PASS in iteration_51.)

action_items: Optional: add a bulk 'Delete pending invite' action in the Pending Invites panel to help admins clean out stale test/typo invites (currently only Resend is available; no Cancel/Delete UI). Recommend adding DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} usage or a dedicated cancel-invite endpoint accessible from the panel.
Optional cosmetic: consider auto-expiring invites in the panel after the 7-day token expiry (right now they linger indefinitely until manually deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py resend_invite raises 502 with a generic message when Resend fails — good, but consider surfacing the underlying error (currently only logged via print). A structured error dict would help debug production email failures.

_invite_base_url derives from request Origin header only; if an admin hits the API via curl/postman with no Origin, it falls back to SITE_URL. That's correct, but noting so future refactors don't accidentally point preview invites at production.

admin_routes.py file is 3485 lines — significantly over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting (users/orders/products/media/content each into own module). Not blocking this feature but flagged for future refactor.

In UserCreate the default role is 'adult' (models) but the frontend invite modal shows 'member' as default — verify role vocabulary consistency across UI/backend/roles map (ROLES dict has admin/instructor/student/adult; 'member' is not in that map).
